name: Costco Wholesale Corporation
owner_fcf_base: Owner FCF = FY2025 reported FCF $7.84B (OCF $13.335B - capex $5.498B) minus 100% SBC $0.86B = ~$6.98B; grown to a ~$7.4B forward (FY2026) base for the DCF. Note: a large portion of Costco's $5.5B capex is growth capex (new warehouse openings), so reported FCF structurally understates true owner/maintenance earnings — a known reason pure DCF under-credits this compounder.

conservador.note: Phase1 (yr1-5) 7% CAGR, Phase2 (6-10) declining 7%->4%, terminal g 2.5%, WACC 8.55%. Reasonable-pessimist: membership/comp growth moderates, club expansion slows, margin flat. NOT apocalyptic. +$11.76B net cash added.

base.note: Phase1 10% CAGR, Phase2 declining 10%->5%, terminal g 3.0%, WACC 8.55%. Consensus-like: ~8-10% revenue growth, steady ~90% renewal, modest margin lift, continued unit growth + occasional special dividend optionality.

optimista.note: Phase1 12% CAGR, Phase2 declining 12%->6%, terminal g 3.5%, WACC 8.55%. International + e-comm acceleration, membership fee increases, faster club rollout, durable pricing power.

multiple_metric: Forward P/E on FY2026 consensus EPS (~$20.52)
multiple_rationale: Costco trades at fwd P/E ~43.5 (aggregator) to ~46.4 (on explicit FY26 consensus EPS $20.52), vs a 5y average of ~45.8. There is NO structural deterioration — fundamentals are accelerating (Q3 FY26 net sales +11.6%, comps +6.6% ex gas/fx, GAAP EPS +15% YoY, 89.7% worldwide / 92.2% US-Canada renewal, 148.5M cardholders, ROIC ~20%, net cash). I apply a modest ~8% haircut to the 5y avg (42x vs 45.8x) purely for valuation discipline given the extreme absolute multiple (~50x trailing) and PEG ~4.4, not for any business deterioration. iv_multiple = 20.52 * 42 = ~$862.
structural_change: None. No structural deterioration. Costco is an accelerating, proven compounder: Q3 FY2026 net sales +11.6%, comps +6.6% ex gas/fx, GAAP EPS $4.93 (+15% YoY), worldwide renewal 89.7% (US-Canada 92.2%), 148.5M cardholders, ROIC ~20%, +$11.76B net cash, exceptionally clean comp structure (SBC just 0.31% of revenue / ~11% of FCF). The ~13% pullback from the May 2026 ATH ($1,096.50) is valuation/fear rotation, not earnings deterioration.
sanity_notes: Price $951.35 and shares ~443.5M re-verified on StockAnalysis.com and Yahoo (price ~$950-951; both report ~443.5M shares). Implied mcap = 951.35 * 0.4435 = $421.9B, matching the known ~$422B scale (mcap_sanity_ok=true). MAGNITUDE CHECK: reconciled IV $731 = 77% of the $951 price, well within the 30-300% sanity band, so no shares/currency/units error. Pure DCF ($488 weighted) sits at 51% of price — a textbook case of DCF under-crediting a compounder reinvesting at ~20% ROIC for decades, and of reported FCF understating owner earnings because a large share of the $5.5B capex is growth (new clubs), not maintenance. Hence the multiple anchor is weighted more heavily (0.65) as it is the more reliable gauge for a stable, proven compounder; DCF kept at 0.35 as a discipline floor. Reconciled IV ~$731 implies the stock currently trades ~30% ABOVE estimated fair value — quality business, but priced for perfection at ~50x trailing earnings; limited margin of safety at $951.
